searchText: In current/prev devnets, have we tried sending a voluntary exit which validator already has a pending balance to withdrawal? I've tried it before, but I can write a playbook to have it in assertoor and regularly tested Thanks, the only condition to watch out for is a pending withdrawal in the happy case will stay in the state for `MAX_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + MIN_VALIDATOR_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY` so the exit will have to be consumed before this : )
